intro: Dispatch Commander Ruag bristles when asked about the missing orders, insisting they were relayed. Ruag says the soldiers carrying them were ambushed by murlocs and only one lived, and sends you to speak with Bengor.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The orders? What could you possibly want with the orders?

What are you implying, friend? Of course I relayed those orders! The soldiers I sent the orders with were ambushed and brutally beaten by murlocs. Only one survived, if you can call that surviving. He can hardly speak, cannot walk, and must be fed through a tube. If you want to know what happened to those orders, speak with Bengor. I'm sure he is around here somewhere... And, friend, be mindful of what you stick your nose into - it may get bitten off.
